label: Maternal deaths
reliability_criteria: Canonical tier = UN DYB Table 17 registered maternal-death counts (the Number rows, WHO-collected cause-of-death statistics), 13 editions 2001-2022 (2015 recovered v10, wired v12), C/U/|/+ quality-coded as printed — the counts exist for MORE countries than the ratios because the collector's editorial rule refuses ratios, not counts, on data it judges incomplete. Medium, not high: maternal deaths are the classic under-reported cause even inside otherwise-complete civil registration (obstetric deaths misclassified to disease chapters), and the registered counts inherit that undercount as-reported. Witness tier = UN MMEIG modeled number of maternal deaths via the World Bank (SH.MMR.DTHS, the 2023 round, annual 1985-2023), which models the counts precisely where registration cannot serve them.
license: Mixed, per source (see "sources"): UN DYB = UN data reuse policy (attribution required, no endorsement implied); World Bank witness = CC-BY-4.0 (content: UN MMEIG estimates).
notes:
THE COUNTS HALF OF THE MATERNAL BLOC (v12): the same DYB Table 17 the ratio indicator reads, at the other block — `field: number` selects the "Number - Nombre" rows (registered maternal deaths) instead of the "Rate - Taux" rows (the UNSD-computed ratio). The two indicators share editions, quality codes, footnote refs and the entity space; they differ in one structural way: the counts block is WIDER, because the collector's editorial rule ("rates only for data judged complete enough") refuses ratios, never counts. A Number-ONLY country — Libya in the 2024 edition, 47 of the 124 count-printing countries in the 2015 edition (verified live 2026-09-13) — leaves no point in the ratio indicator but a full series here. The v9 scope-limit note ("wiring the counts as a separate decision") is closed by this file.
AS-REPORTED, BOTH DEPTHS: like the ratio, a Number cell can print "..." (year with no count) or "-" (nil) — kept as value=null gap points carrying the printed quality code, and merged across the 13 editions by the standard vintage discipline (later edition wins, every arbitration logged in maternal_deaths.provenance.json). The row's C/U/|/+ completeness code rides every point as printed, including the U/+U codes the ratio indicator rarely sees (counts are published on incomplete data too — that is the point of this indicator).
THE DIAMOND IS A RATE-ROW ANNOTATION: "♦" (ratio based on 30 or fewer maternal deaths) marks ratio cells, not counts — verified on the 2015 file (341 diamonds on Rate rows, ZERO on Number rows, live 2026-09-13). This indicator therefore carries small_base nowhere in the real files; the transport supports it anyway (the parser reads the marker cell of whatever block it is asked for). No sex dimension: the table prints one Number row per country (no Male/Female split to report), so every canonical point carries sex absent and (entity, year) is the merge key.
WITNESS TIER, ONE DOOR OF ONE ROOT (un_mmeig): worldbank SH.MMR.DTHS — the MMEIG modeled number of maternal deaths, 2023 round, annual 1985-2023, integer print (verified live: India 1985 = 180,000, the witness band's top; Egypt 2020 = 750 where the OWID door of the RATIO indicator carries 16.8 — counts and ratio are different measures of the same modeled reality). OWID publishes no deaths column on its maternal-mortality chart (verified live 2026-09-13), so the World Bank is the single door for now; GHO's MORT_MATERNALNUM is the natural second door when phase 5's GHO dims handling grows. The canonical/ witness spread is the displayable signal, orders of magnitude wide where registration fails entirely (Egypt's registered counts vs its modeled counts) and near-identical where it holds (France-class registrators).
THE WITNESS GRID (WDI's own print): SH.MMR.DTHS arrives as WDI's full 1960-2025 year grid; the series itself is valued 1985-2023 (annual, ~194 entities every year, verified live 2026-09-13). The year slots outside the series' window (1960-1984, 2024-2025) ride as explicit null gap points — the same null discipline as the trailing-2025 slots on the IGME codes, readable as "the provider prints no estimate for this slot", never silently dropped. The entities with no MMEIG estimate at all (23 of WDI's 217 country-classified entities) stay as all-gap witness series.
